name: MKTG 3757
title: Strategic Brand Management
description: (Also offered as BADM 3757.) This course provides an introduction to building, leveraging, and enhancing brand equity and making strategic brand decisions. Students learn to design brands, build brand communities, measure brand performance, manage a brand portfolio, and conduct brand assessments.
requirement_description: MKTG 3101 or BADM 3750; open only to business majors of junior or higher status.
